description: This file defines the LogNode interface which is a core part of a logging system used in Android development. It specifies a contract for implementing classes to handle log messages, allowing for customizable logging chains.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain that can output log data to various targets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, including log level, tag, message, and optional exception.
